steps.content: You've already searched the entire room, and have learned everything you need to know. There are huge claw marks tearing apart the walls and floor near where you and Mess ingested Ambrosia.
This is the "black goo" that Mess spat out. It's what the silly dragon Draco should actually look like. You still know nothing about her battles and experiences in real life.
You only know that Mess chose to come back herself.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: I heard that you woke up, Chief.
steps.female_content: I heard that you woke up, Ma'am.

steps.content: What quick timing.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Mr. Doyle has already discovered the truth. He's really quite sharp. It took him no time at all to see through our little plan. He threw a huge tantrum, and demands to settle accounts with you.

options: Can you help me out with this? Or maybe transfer him away?

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Haha, no need. Inspector Doyle is highly productive. We acquired a lot of interesting information about Quinn from him.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: It's been a long time since I've seen him so motivated. I think the inspector regained his passion thanks to you.

You're surprised to hear this, but you also feel... comforted. If Doyle can get his life back together, then it's great news. As long as he is well-protected, he can lend you the wisdom of an incredible inspector.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Guess we have to seek help from the incredible inspector.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A decisive battle is coming soon. It's not something that can be settled by just dealing with a Sinner kid. Please update him with the latest intel. I still need to rely on his wisdom.
You update the 9th Agency on Mess's investigation results, and start writing an email to Doyle.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: What fruitful results... Sleepwalking has greatly increased among civilians recently. With this transaction record, the investigation can finally make a breakthrough. Thank you so much.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: As for your target, the woman who is Mess's supplier and the maker of Ambrosia... I guess we found some interesting info about her, too.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: The woman calls herself <color=#fb9259>Serpent</color>. She's a freelance entertainer and circus performer who is somewhat famous in Eastside's high-class salons.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Two weeks ago, she signed a contract with Quinn to perform regularly at the Midsummer Night's Club. We found nothing suspicious about this, nor did it trigger the Mania alarm.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But I'm certain she's a Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Either she's extremely careful, or someone powerful is protecting her.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: I think probably both. At least in this case, her employer is highly suspicious.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: That's right. The shadow of Outland capital has always lurked behind Quinn. Plus, they show a strong interest in the Hypercube industry. The Outland Affairs Bureau is keeping an eye on them for the security of our city-state.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: But Inspector Doyle discovered other interesting things... The M-value detection network in District 14 has been tampered with, and there is a hidden escape door near the Midsummer Night's Club.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Further investigation found that Miss Eirene, the President of Quinn and a rising star in Eastside's business world, privately met with multiples Sinners at the Midsummer Night's Club.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Perhaps she built the secret escape door to cover up her plan to exploit the Sinners. If I dare to make an even bolder guess, perhaps... she's a Sinner herself?

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Haha, I'm going off-topic. We need more evidence to confirm Quinn's actual involvement in this incident. But at least it is certain that Sinner Serpent is the mastermind behind this series of events.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: She accepted Quinn's employment offer and hid in the club to mask the M-value fluctuations of her powers when she made Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's why she used Mess to spread Ambrosia out there.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: That's right. Sinner Mess brought Ambrosia to mass consumers, while the Midsummer Night's Club catered to Ambrosia's high-end clientele. If her direct motive is to spread Ambrosia and create Sleepwalkers...

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: The 9th Agency predicts that Serpent will do something big at the Midsummer Night's Club's opening ceremony two days from now.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Sounds like it'll be tough to handle.

steps.content: You tell the 9th Agency about the information on <color=#fb9259>Marv</color>.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: ...If it's related to that serious case many years ago, then it makes matters even worse. We will contact the FAC as soon as possible to obtain the dossier.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: In this case, Inspector Doyle's experience is indispensable. He's the incredible inspector who had come into contact with the Marv case.
Ring ring...
A call comes in. You see that it's from Doyle.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Speak of the devil. Please answer it, but be prepared to get yelled at.
You really don't want to get yelled at by Doyle... You look at the phone and reluctantly pick up.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Hey... Hey... Noms... You new... Don't do anything rash... Wait for me... Wait till I come back... I'll take you...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Na... Nasha... I'm here... I'm... coming...
After a load of confusing drivel, you hear the call hang up.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: He called to yell at you?

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: My apologies. Apologize to him when it's all over. He'll forgive you.
...That crafty plan had been the 9th Agency's idea in the first place.
But Doyle's voice didn't sound angry on the phone. It even sounded a bit... sweet and nauseating. Maybe things are going unexpectedly well on his side, too.
Maybe your crafty plan unexpectedly... helped him?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Go meet up first. Better to talk about the plan details face-to-face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll update the inspector on the intel first.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: All right. We will meet you soon to discuss the plan.

October 3, N.F. 112, 9:44 PM
Eastside - Doyle's home
Doyle lies on the sofa like a dead man. All the lights in the room are turned off. He checks the phone in his hand every few minutes.

13:59:12
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: I'm fine. I didn't message you.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Really? But the hospital contacted me and said you got into a car accident. I couldn't get ahold of you, either.
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: Maybe it was a prank.
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: My phone wasn't working for a while this afternoon. Focus on your work.
You've always... been busy.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: ...I'm glad you're okay.

14:04:22
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: ...Nasha, maybe you don't want to see me anymore, but I still want to tell you...
If you run into trouble, don't bear it alone. I'm always here for you.

16:27:42
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: Go back, Doyle. Move on.
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: We all need to move on.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...It's over. I should've known... I'm so stupid. What was I hoping for...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Think about something else, Doyle... You're an inspector...
The phone vibrates again. He opens it glumly to take a look. The message isn't from Nasha, but from the rookie detective from the 9th Agency... Or rather, the mysterious MBCC Chief.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: You've the audacity to pop up after tricking me so bad...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Inspector, I discovered some interesting things. I'm reporting them to you right away, so please forgive me!

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...What a hot-headed rookie. All right, then. I'm the senior one, after all.
In reality, he really needs this to distract himself. The inspector gradually immerses himself in the case again, forgetting the suffocating anguish just now.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: So it's related to the "Marv" case after all... This complicates things...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: The maker of Ambrosia can spy on the dreams of the Sleepwalkers, as well as separate and filter consciousness... What the heck does that mean? I want some more solid intelligence...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Ah, here. A photo of the suspect. A performer for Quinn? Hehe, I was going to check out the company's latest hires anyway... Let's see who it is...
He opens the newly sent photo. The woman in it is smiling sweetly. Doyle freezes.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: So this is... Serpent? I've seen this woman...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Not at the club, but at... that bar?!
His nerves immediately tense up, and his brain starts racing.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...According to that rookie's intel, she's extremely cautious and almost never leaves the club. She even conducts her Ambrosia sales through middlemen.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Then why did she go out that night to somewhere so far away...?

steps.speaker: Woman in Shadow
steps.content: It's such a lovely evening. Why don't I cheer you up with something sweet? Here, my treat.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: She came specifically to find me and make me drink Ambrosia... She knew I was handling the case, so I was targeted...

steps.speaker: Woman in Shadow
steps.content: Even though there's only a bit left, I promise you'll like it...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: But she controlled the dosage to ensure that I don't Sleepwalk... She wanted me to remain conscious... Why...

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: The maker of Ambrosia can spy on the dreams of the Sleepwalkers.
He immediately stops reading any more messages from the MBCC and shuts his phone. An indescribable chill grips him. He'd forget everything if he could, or at least knock himself out.
Not only can she spy on dreams, but everything that Ambrosia touches! This woman has been spying on the authorities through the eyes of the "incredible inspector" Doyle himself!
She knows everything. Fighting her is futile. The sly vixen has already prepared for it. ${PlayerName}'s plan will become a trap for themselves. They must be notified right away...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: There's no time. I have to leave a message, quick... ****, we don't have any shared secret signals or codewords... Ugh, that won't work anyways. She'll deal with that too.
The woman is coming. She knows that Doyle knows everything. She won't spare him.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Phone... Phone phone phone...
He dials ${PlayerName}'s number as quickly as he can.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: ...The number you are dialing is busy. Please wait and try again...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ****! A message! A note! Anything, and...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: My gun! Where's my gun?!
He wants to leave a clue that he was attacked, so that ${PlayerName} can take it as a warning. But Doyle had given his gun to ${PlayerName} before rushing off to find Nasha.
As he frenziedly taps into his messaging app to send a voice message, his phone vibrates. A new message notification appears at the top of the screen. Sender: "Nasha."
Doyle feels his whole body freeze.
As the voice message prompt continues to repeat itself, he taps the notification with a trembling finger to check the message.

22:26:25
<color=#fb9259>Nasha</color>: You're always like this... Stop thinking about work. Think about me.
The light shines through the glass window, illuminating a ring suspended in the air, and the silhouette of the woman swaying inside it.
Doyle stiffens and turns around slowly, this is the second time he saw her. She was holding Nasha's phone with a sweet smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I came to see you, darling.

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: Inspector?

The blue-haired girl gently hugs the inspector, who vomits black goo and falls into a deep sleep. She picks up the phone, holds it to his mouth to deliver his last words, then gently presses the end call button.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...Now, enjoy your sweet dream.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You don't have to be sad anymore...

October 4, N.F. 112, 9:00 PM
MBCC Command Center

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: A Mania crisis has broken out at the Midsummer Night's Club! All surveillance points have gone silent! The M-value range has expanded, affecting 33% of District 14. Mania crisis level: B+... A... A+... It's still increasing!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What's happening at the scene?!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This M-value... It's an S-Class Sinner energy crisis...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}!
